message.content:
洛杉磯（美國太平洋時間）與柏林（歐洲中部時間）的時差通常是 **9 小時**，即柏林比洛杉磯早 9 小時。

> **注意：**  
> - 兩地都實行夏令時間（DST），但開始與結束日期略有不同。  
> - 在美國夏令時間開始（3 月第二個星期日）到歐洲夏令時間開始（3 月最後一個星期日）之間，洛杉磯已進入夏令時間，而柏林仍處於標準時間，時差為 **8 小時**。  
> - 在歐洲夏令時間結束（10 月最後一個星期日）到美國夏令時間結束（11 月第一個星期日）之間，柏林已進入夏令時間，而洛杉磯仍處於標準時間，時差為 **10 小時**。  

如果你需要某個具體日期的精確時差，請告訴我日期，我可以幫你算出那天的差距。

Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (PT), Berlin is Central European Time (CET). Standard difference: Berlin is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles. But during daylight saving time, Los Angeles is PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin is CEST (UTC+2). So difference remains 9 hours. Actually, both observe DST, but offset difference remains 9 hours. However, there might be times when one is on DST and the other not? Let's check: In the US, DST starts second Sunday in March, ends first Sunday in November. In Europe, DST starts last Sunday in March, ends last Sunday in October. So there is a period from March 8 to March 31 where Los Angeles is on DST (PDT) and Berlin is still on standard time (CET). During that period, difference is 8 hours. Similarly, from October 29 to November 3, Berlin is on DST (CEST) and Los Angeles is on standard time (PST). During that period, difference is 10 hours. So the difference varies over the year. The question likely expects a general answer: 9 hours difference. But we can mention the variations. The user didn't specify a date.
